text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed from control-plane dependencies (auth/org-lookup/billing/config). 5m avg 5xx = 9.8%, spike started ~<5m ago. Pager escalation initiated. @Maya (oncall) paged.
Maya (oncall): Ack. jumping in. severity = P1? seeing user-facing gateway 502/504s.
Jon (eng-runtime): I'm seeing increased tail latency on auth calls -> org-lookup timeouts at the gateway. logs: ```[2026-03-15T18:21:10Z] auth-proxy -> org-lookup svc timeout=10000ms err=upstream_timeout status=504```
Priya (eng-platform): Also seeing config-service returning 503s in us-east-1, looks correlated. CPU for config instances is normal. suspect dependency fanout.
Sam (sre): Confirmed traffic pattern: a config rollout triggered a metadata fetch cascade to auth and billing. 90th latency for org-lookup jumped from 120ms -> 5.2s.
Lee (support): field reports: customers A123, B-Analytics, and several orgs see failed inference requests. Customer-facing error % ~ 6% overall.
Maya (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) pause rolling config rollout 2) enable circuit-breaker on gateway for org-lookup 3) fallback to cached org data for 10m 4) throttle non-essential background jobs.
Jon (eng-runtime): On it — pausing rollout now (deploy bot cmd): ```/deploy pause rollout config-service us-east-1```
OpsBot: deploy job accepted — rollout for config-service us-east-1 paused by Maya.
Priya (eng-platform): Flipping gateway CB to short-circuit org-lookup failures -> returning 200 from cache while upstream heals. Patch: ```gateway.set_cb('org-lookup', fail_open=true, ttl_cache=600s)```
Sam (sre): Applying temporary autoscale override on org-lookup to add capacity: bump desired from 3 -> 9. will watch.
Jon (eng-runtime): Also reduce org-lookup client timeout from 10s -> 2s to avoid request queue amplification. will push small config.
Maya (oncall): Sam, Jon — please coordinate so we don't cause more retries. Sam, remove queued retries at LB if possible.
Sam (sre): We reduced client-side retries and disabled retry-on-5xx for now. LB drain of queued connections in progress.
Lee (support): Noting mitigating message to customers: "We are aware of intermittent 5xx errors affecting control-plane lookups and have activated fallbacks. Please expect degraded performance for a short time." Who sends?
Maya (oncall): I'll post the customer note. @Lee tag me if any VIPs escalate.
Jon (eng-runtime): After CB + cache fallback + reduced timeouts we see 5xx down to ~1.7% in the last 2m. latency 95th dropped from 5s -> 350ms.
Priya (eng-platform): config-service errors dropped after pause. Seems rollout triggered a metadata fanout to org-lookup and billing. billing svc saw a sudden spike in auth lookups and hit rate limiter -> 503.
Sam (sre): Suggest next steps: 1) continue pause for 15m, 2) run controlled retry sweep on backlog with rate-limit, 3) prepare gradual rollout with traffic-limited canary and verification.
Maya (oncall): Agreed. I'm updating incident doc and requesting postmortem. Logging timeline and actions in incident tracker: https://incidents/internal/2891002345 (placeholder).
Lee (support): Logging affected customers and tickets: TCK-4321, TCK-4322, sent brief to account owners.
Jon (eng-runtime): Monitoring: watch auth/org-lookup 95p and rate-limiter counters. current dashboards: https://dash/realtime/org-lookup, https://dash/realtime/billing-rate-limiter
Priya (eng-platform): Planning: add defensive circuit-breakers on config rollout path and small randomized jitter on metadata pulls to avoid thundering herd.
Sam (sre): Requesting oncall rotation handoff at +2h. @Priya can you stay for initial RCA?
Priya (eng-platform): I can.
Maya (oncall): Handoff note: current state = degraded->mitigating. 5xx reduced to ~1-2%. actions taken: paused rollout, enabled CB + cache fallback, scaled org-lookup, reduced timeouts, disabled retries, throttled background jobs. Owner for follow-up: Priya/Jon/Sam.
IncidentBot: NOTE: Pager silence will be enabled for duplicate alerts while this thread is active.
Lee (support): Will keep customers updated. I'll collate affected org list for postmortem.
Maya (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated for live customer impact; leaving open for RCA. moving to oncall->followup. thanks all. :heart:
Sam (sre): Filing a targeted runbook update to avoid rollout -> fanout coupling.
Jon (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a small test to simulate metadata fanout and show mitigation steps.
Maya (oncall): Handoff to followup team. releasing pager to next rotation.
Priya (eng-platform): Logged actions + timeline in internal doc. Postmortem requested and assigned to Priya.
Lee (support): final note: customers A123 and B-Analytics confirmed recovery. closing customer tickets after followup email.
Maya (oncall): closing thread for live mitigation. postmortem + RCA to follow. :white_check_mark:
